h3: What are ATM – Brown Label ATM (BLA) Services?
p: Expand Your ATM Network. Without the Investment.

ORITSO's Brown Label ATM (BLA) service allows banks to expand their ATM footprint without owning, deploying, or maintaining the machines themselves. Under ORITSO's BLA model, ORITSO owns and operates the ATM hardware and takes responsibility for all technology, maintenance, and compliance — while the bank retains full branding rights and earns revenue from transactions. For cooperative banks and smaller financial institutions, deploying a dedicated ATM network is expensive and operationally complex. The Brown Label ATM model removes all of these barriers — giving the bank's customers 24×7 cash access under the bank's own brand, without any infrastructure investment from the bank.

p: Protecting Every High-Value Cheque. Before It Is Processed.

PPS (Positive Pay System) is ORITSO's cheque security solution that enables account holders to pre-intimate their bank before issuing a high-value cheque. Before the cheque is presented for payment, the bank verifies the cheque details — such as date, amount, payee name, and cheque number — against the information submitted by the account holder. If there is any mismatch, the cheque is flagged and held for review. This significantly reduces the risk of cheque fraud and unauthorised alterations.

Cheque fraud and tampering are growing concerns for banks and their customers. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has mandated the Positive Pay System for all cheques above a specified value to protect account holders from financial loss. ORITSO's PPS solution makes this process simple, fast, and fully compliant — for both the bank and its customers.
Banks and financial institutions that process high-value cheques need to comply with the RBI's Positive Pay System mandate while protecting their customers from cheque fraud.

Oritso designed and deployed a centralized Cheque Truncation System (CTS) infrastructure for the Post Office Savings Bank, enabling seamless cheque processing across one of the largest and most distributed banking networks in India. The solution was built to accommodate operational realities, including limited connectivity, manual workflows, and decentralized branch operations.

By introducing a centrally controlled architecture with branch-level flexibility, Oritso ensured uninterrupted clearing operations even amid branch-level disruptions. The platform has consistently supported regulatory compliance, scaled with increasing transaction volumes, and enabled POSB to transition smoothly to advanced frameworks such as the Continuous Cheque Truncation System (CCTS).
